q1_issues.issue: The temporal filler `quarter_moon` is a compound symbol fused from the surface but carries no decomposition — Compound concepts makes the head genus `(Inheritance quarter_moon moon)` mandatory for any compound symbol minted this way (cf. the `room_temperature` condition symbol, which is decomposed).

q2_gaps: a recurring natural-cycle time slot as a temporal adjunct ("at the quarter moons"): the Time-term inventory (Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute), the deictic constants and the day-part constants have no form for a lunar phase, and the frequency/habitual "a named slot also implies its cycle" table (monday->week, morning->day, month->year) has no entry for one either, so neither a structured term nor an `(Every e 1 <cycle>)` recurrence atom is derivable

a definite-plural NP used as the object of a temporal adjunct ("at **the** quarter moons"): the ordinary NP rules would mint a group witness with `GroupOf`, but a `Time` filler is a bare term, and the instruction set never reconciles the two for a definite-plural time expression
notes: Routing "occur" through the light-verb-over-event-noun rule (time atoms straight onto the tide, no separate `occur` event) and the bare-generic rule form at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase companion are both correct. `(Inheritance neap_tide neap)` is borderline: `neap` is dictionary-adjectival and marginally predicable ("the tide is neap"), but it falls outside the gradable / positional / material list the modifier-genus rule enumerates.
